Figure 5 illustrates the training dynamics of LUFFY compared with on-policy RL, presenting three metrics plotted against training steps: left panel shows outcome training rewards, middle panel shows generation length, and right panel shows generation entropy. The x-axis in all panels is labeled "Steps" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 100,000 steps, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 10,000 steps. The y-axis in the left panel is labeled "Outcome Training Rewards" and ranges from 0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis in the middle panel is labeled "Generation Length" and ranges from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The y-axis in the right panel is labeled "Generation Entropy" and ranges from 0 to 3.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The left panel contains a solid blue line representing "On-policy RL" and a dashed red line representing "LUFFY", both starting near 0 and rising to near 1.0. The middle panel contains a solid blue line representing "On-policy RL" and a dashed red line representing "LUFFY", both starting near 0 and rising to near 100. The right panel contains a solid blue line representing "On-policy RL" and a dashed red line representing "LUFFY", both starting near 0 and rising to near 3.0. The right panel also includes a solid black line labeled "Continuous Exploration", which starts near 0 and rises to near 3.0.

Figure 4 illustrates the training rewards of LLAMA-3.1 8B on two distinct training sets: Easy and Hard. The top panel plots training rewards against steps for the Easy training set, with the x-axis labeled "Steps" and using a linear scale ranging from 0 to 200,000 steps, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 50,000 steps. The y-axis is labeled "Training Reward" and ranges from 0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The bottom panel plots training rewards against steps for the Hard training set, with the x-axis labeled "Steps" and using a linear scale ranging from 0 to 200,000 steps, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 50,000 steps. The y-axis is labeled "Training Reward" and ranges from 0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Both panels contain three lines: a solid blue line labeled "LLama-On-Policy-Easy", a dashed red line labeled "LLama-LUFFY-Easy", and a solid black line labeled "LLama-On-Policy-Hard". In the top panel, all three lines start near 0 and rise to near 1.0. In the bottom panel, all three lines start near 0 and rise to near 1.0.
